We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the sample's compound. We have no direct description of the sample. We need to infer from NMR? Probably we need to get 1H NMR spectrum and count methyl signals. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (no input needed? It says takes SMILES string, but no parameters). The tool signature: proton_nmr_spectra(_: {}) => any. No arguments. So it will return the 1H NMR for the sample at hand (the unknown). Then we can count methyl peaks (singlets around 0.9-1.2 ppm maybe). Could also use carbon NMR to count methyl carbons (around 10-30 ppm). Simpler: get carbon NMR and count signals in that region.

We need to minimize cost. Probably just get carbon NMR and count methyl carbons. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool.

Let's call carbon_nmr_spectra.
